diagnostic_evidence: Week7 source-only AUC=0.6417 and best adaptation AUC=0.7458 stay below 0.80; Week9 post-hoc few-shot reaches AUC=0.9250 at 5 shots per class.
paper_safe_interpretation: Philippines is a hard transfer target that becomes recoverable with small target supervision; Week7 alone does not establish robust unsupervised transfer.

paper_safe_interpretation: Ontario should be used only as licensed-consistency/anomaly-style boundary evidence, not as a standard transfer success.
